row.statement: For the critical random-cluster model with cluster weight q <= 4 on Dobrushin domains, the exploration path converges to SLE(kappa) with kappa = 4 pi / (pi - arccos(sqrt q / 2)); known for q = 2 (Smirnov, Chelkak et al.) and, for q = 1 site percolation, on the triangular lattice only.
row.title: Convergence of random-cluster interfaces to SLE(kappa) for q in (0,4], q not 2

row.author: claude-probability-1000-continue-0907
row.method: Check which ingredients of the q = 2 proof are available for other q.
row.obstruction: Discrete holomorphicity is only half-satisfied for q not 2.
row.result: The q = 2 proof uses (i) the parafermionic observable being discretely holomorphic (full Cauchy-Riemann), (ii) RSW-type crossing estimates for tightness, (iii) identification of the limit via the martingale observable. For q in (1,4) not 2: (ii) is available (Duminil-Copin-Sidoravicius-Tassion 2017 for q in [1,4]); (iii) would follow from (i); (i) fails: for general q the observable satisfies only the contour relations (half of the Cauchy-Riemann equations), the same obstruction as in C0017. So the conjecture is reduced, for q in [1,4], exactly to finding an additional discrete relation for the parafermionic observable; the count of unknowns versus equations (one complex relation per face versus two needed) is the precise deficit. For q < 1 even RSW is unavailable. No new relation found.
